string.text: Ha... ha... I finally... found you. Hurry, let me in!
WA2000? I'm happy to have you back!
What are you standing around for? Hurry up and come here!

Um, if you can't make it in the Yellow Zones anymore in the future, you could come find me in the Green Zones. I have an apartment there, it's not big, but it's enough for two people. I can do some commissions for money- Hey, that's an if, IF! Do you understand?!
Okay Makiatto, that's enough. Please head back to base.
So, before... well... I mean, I'm sorry...
